scoring_justification: The headline is nine computed adsorption energies from periodic DFT, which are inherently method-dependent; the checker compares the reported values to the paper's reported gold with a tolerance of ±0.5 eV to absorb code/functional/pseudopotential differences. Recomputing from raw logs is not feasible in the verifier sandbox because it would require running DFT.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold adsorption energy values for the nine surface-adsorbate combinations, used to score the agent's computed energies within a tolerance of ±0.5 eV.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and text (NH3_V: -6.070 eV, NH3_Pd: -6.785 eV, Benzene_Pd: -6.335 eV, O2_V: -5.848 eV, O2_Pd: -7.286 eV, NO_V_N: -5.375 eV, NO_Pd_N: -8.447 eV, NO2_Pd_N: -7.593 eV, NO2_Pd_O: -7.068 eV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported DFT adsorption energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published DFT results; using them ensures the checker validates reproduction of the paper's computational findings.

outputs.description: JSON file containing computed adsorption energies (eV) for NH₃, benzene, O₂, NO, and NO₂ on PdV/TiO₂(101) surface at specified sites.

output_contract.notes: The adsorbate sites and exact reference values are hidden; scoring compares each value to the paper-reported energy within a generous tolerance to absorb DFT implementation differences.
